scope: Local technical POC; fictional contractual cases, not validated investor behavior or macroeconomics
core: BPTK-Py 3.5.0; original tools/probe_bptk_hybrid.py unchanged; Python adapter and React/Tailwind UI

checks: reproducible rows and events across independent runs
nonnegative available cash and explicit arrears
custom 3.7% HTTP request reaches solver: month 3 variable interest 185, cash 1215
automated.build: npm run build --prefix poc passed: strict TypeScript and Vite production build

observations: 6% month 3: variable interest 300, headroom and earmark 0; fixed interest 100, headroom 200, earmark 100
6% deposit month 6 cash 3600; baseline difference 800; cumulative earmark 600
editing input preserves last computed rate and marks uncomputed change
4% recalculation returns new run ID and computed-rate label
simulated request rejection clears computed view and shows error; restored fetch and recalculation recover
clickable flow explanations, case selection and month selection work
desktop and mobile screenshots visually inspected; final 320px DOM check: no horizontal overflow or clipped flow nodes
production build served on same local API port and rendered actual result
browser.console: no errors or warnings observed during interactive checks
browser.failure_injection: Temporary fetch rejection in owned browser page only, restored afterwards

network: No external model or data service required for simulation; assets bundled locally
limits: No pedagogical study or user comprehension test yet
No empirical personas, full banking ledger, rate-transmission calibration, inflation or market-price simulation
Investment earmark is a separate cash pot, not a securities purchase
No security audit or public deployment
Full cross-process state restoration and LLM decisions not implemented
